sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, The Hockey revolves around scoring goals by navigating a small hockey puck through a rink. The game is played on a single screen, with the puck moving in a straight line until it hits the opponent's goal. The objective is to score as many goals as possible within the given time limit. The game features simple controls that allow players to move the puck left or right using the mouse or keyboard, making it easy to pick up and play.

One of the key features of The Hockey is its physics-based gameplay. The puck moves at a steady pace, and its trajectory can be influenced by the player's input. This creates a sense of challenge and unpredictability, as players must time their movements perfectly to score goals. The game also features a power-up system, which allows players to earn bonus points and temporary boosts to their puck's speed and size.
